title: Smoked Tagine-Style Japanese Chickpea Bowl
description: A twist on traditional Japanese cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of Algeria with a smoky twist.

ingredients.name: Algerian Tagine Spice Mix
ingredients.notes: or substitute with Japanese curry powder

instructions: 1. Heat coconut oil in a large pan over medium heat.
2. Add sesame oil and swirl to coat.
3. Add the chickpeas and cook until lightly browned.
4. Add the Algerian Tagine Spice Mix and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
7. Stir in the fiery chili flakes and smoked paprika.
8. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
9. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve over rice or noodles.
